nodes.long_description:
# Train Like a Real Boxer

Boxing Drills VR brings authentic pad training to your Quest. No gym required.

**Realistic Drills**

Follow a virtual trainer through classic boxing combinations:
- **1-2 (Jab-Cross)** - The fundamental combo
- **1-2-Duck** - Add defensive movement
- **1-2-3** - Jab, Cross, Hook
- **1-2-3-2** - Extended combinations
- **Uppercut combos** - Work those body shots
- **Growing Library** - A vast selection of drills with new content added regularly!

**Built for Performance**

We know every millisecond counts when you're in the pocket.
- Low-Latency Precision: Built from the ground up for high-performance tracking.
- Native Feel: Optimized to ensure smooth, responsive feedback that feels like hitting real pads.

**Get Scored**

Every session tracks your performance:
- **Power** - Hit those pads hard
- **Speed** - Quick reactions matter
- **Agility** - Duck and weave like a pro
- **Form** - Return to guard after every punch

**Train Your Way**
- Multiple drill durations (30s to 3 min)
- Choose the speed that suits you (slow, medium, fast, progressive, variable)
- Passthrough mode - train safely in your own space

**Perfect For**
- Beginners learning boxing basics
- Fitness enthusiasts wanting a fun workout
- Experienced boxers staying sharp

No experience needed. Just clear some space, put on your Quest, and start throwing punches.

**Shape the Future (Open Source)**

We believe the best training tools are built by the community. We are moving toward an open-source model so the community can help us shape the roadmap of the product.
nodes.short_description: Train like a boxer in VR. Follow realistic pad drills with jabs, crosses, hooks, and uppercuts. Practice defense with duck-and-weave combos. Track your power, speed, and form after every session.

nodes.change_log:
### v0.19.1

**More 3D Equipment**
- **3D pads** — the focus mitts are now proper 3D pads instead of flat cuboids. The punch number floats above each pad, always facing you and easy to read.
- **Slip threats are gloves** — the thing you slip is now an incoming red boxing glove on the matching side (left/right), instead of a red ball.
- **Pull-back threat is a glove** — the shot you pull straight back from is now one big red glove coming at your chin, so it's obvious what's incoming. It's wide, so you can't side-step it — you have to pull back.

**Glove Size Setting**
- New **Glove Size** option to scale your gloves up or down (±50%) to better match your real hands or just your preference.

### v0.19.0

**3D Boxing Gloves**
- Your gloves are now proper 3D boxing gloves instead of plain spheres — a first taste of real equipment in the game.
- This is an early roll-out; 3D pads, bags, and more are on the way.

### v0.18.0

**Inside / Outside Range**
- New **Range** toggle on the Train tab — fight from the outside, or pull in tight for inside work.
- Inside brings the pads in close and squares them up for short hooks, uppercuts, and body shots. Works across Combo, Defense, and Footwork drills.

**Fight Mode: Range Game**
- Opponents now have a range style — swarmers want to fight inside, out-boxers want to stay at range, others are balanced. Their style is shown before each fight.
- Your inside and outside proficiency now shows on your Fighter card and influences your fights — train the range that beats your next opponent.

**New Drill & Punches**
- **OVERHAND DIG**: loop an overhand right over the guard, then dig a left uppercut to the body.
- Two new punches added to the game: the overhand right and the uppercut to the body.

**Equipment**
- The **Heavy Bag** tab is now **Equipment**, grouping the heavy bag, double-end bag, and skip rope together. (Speed ball and more coming in a future update.)

**Other**
- The experimental **Counters** tab (Arthur) is temporarily hidden while we continue work on it, it may or may not be back.

### v0.17.0

**Counters Tab (β)**
- New **COUNTERS** tab — sparring against a live opponent named **Arthur**, who walks in, throws telegraphed punches, and talks back
- Slip or pull his shot, then rip your counter directly into his head or body — no pad, you hit the man himself
- Yellow weakpoints (chin, temples, solar plexus, liver): clean hits **stun** him with a flinch, a grunt, and a delayed return
- Arthur reads your shots — he might slip, duck, or pull your counter, so the same trick won't always land
- Three drills to start: **SLIP & RIP** (slip jab, rip cross), **OVER THE TOP** (cross-only), **STRAIGHT WORK** (jab + cross mix)
- Drill intro popups with "Don't show again" — re-openable via **SHOW DRILL HELP** in the pause menu

**Adaptive Difficulty**
- Drills now quietly adjust their tempo to keep you near a ~75% success rate
- Your chosen speed (Slow / Normal / Fast / Very Fast) sets the baseline; the game speeds up when you're cruising and eases off when you're swamped
- New **Adaptive ON/OFF** toggle next to the speed selector. On by default. Not applied to Heavy Bag, Skip Rope, or Warmup

**Warmup League**
- New pre-Beginner league for sore days, injury recovery, or easing back in — soft taps count as clean hits
- Stats stay clean: no PRs, no fighter stat changes, no season points, Fight tab locked
- League selector now cycles **Custom → Warmup → Beginner → Amateur → Pro**

**Music**
- New **?** button next to the Music setting explaining how to play your own music (Spotify / YouTube Music / etc.) in the background

**Bug Fixes**
- Fixed a randomness bug making "random" drill picks heavily favour the same option
- Fixed Arthur double-flinching on a single stun

### v0.16.0

**Heavy Bag Mode**
- New **HEAVY BAG** drill category with three sessions: 1 min, 3 min, and 5 min
- Freeform striking — no prompts, no expected punches, just hit the bag
- Realistic pendulum physics: bag swings forward, laterally, and rotates based on punch direction and speed
- Bag cylinder tilts to follow its pendulum arc (no more vertical-only cylinder)
- Punch type auto-detected from glove velocity direction at impact:
  - Forward dominant → Jab / Cross
  - Lateral dominant → Left / Right Hook
  - Lateral + downward angle → Left / Right Body Hook
  - Upward dominant → Left / Right Uppercut
- End-of-round stats: total punches, best combo streak, per-punch-type count and average speed, overall average and hardest punch

**Peek-a-Boo Drills**
- Three new Tyson-style peek-a-boo defense drills:
  - **HOOK & DUCK** — Right Hook, duck the counter Left Hook (intro drill)
  - **PEEK-A-BOO HOOKS** — Alternating Right Hook → duck → Left Hook → duck rhythm
  - **PEEK-A-BOO POWER** — Full sequence: Jab → Right Hook → duck → Jab → Left Hook → duck

**Reflex Bar Redesign**
- Duck bar completely redesigned as a pivot-based reflex bar
- Fixed pivot at trainer position; long thin cylinder (1.5 m) rotates around it like a boom arm
- Bar stays aligned along its own length throughout the swing — no more spinning
- Collision uses closest-point-on-line-segment geometry — accurate anywhere along the bar's length
- Can no longer be escaped by leaning back
